summary: Master social media for NGOs. Learn ethical storytelling, digital fundraising, and crisis communication for humanitarian work. Enroll for expert-led training.
lede: Social media training for NGOs covers ethical digital engagement, fundraising, advocacy and crisis communication. It is for NGO communications, fundraising, advocacy and program staff who need to plan responsible campaigns and respond to urgent online issues; participants practice creating content that respects beneficiary dignity, managing misinformation and crisis responses, and using analytics to report engagement and impact.
audienceIntro: This training is essential for professionals who manage the intersection of digital technology and humanitarian delivery.
audience: Public Relations Officers in international development organizations
modules: AI and Automation in NGO Communications
prerequisites: Participants should have at least two years of experience in a communications, fundraising, or program management role within an NGO or humanitarian organization. Familiarity with basic social media platform management (Facebook, X, Instagram) is required. Access to an organizational social media account for practical exercises is recommended but not mandatory.
